description: AGRIBALYSE inventories a few resources on the other quantity basis from the published list -- a kilogram of peat where the list splits peat into a megajoule fuel and a kilogram growing medium, kilograms of wood energy where the list keeps megajoules, energy rows whose published counterpart already exists. On the first five-list build (1 September 2026, b0b8d76) the two peat rows crossed silently onto the megajoule fuel flow and five energy rows minted duplicate flows, one of them in a ground context. The rulings: an agricultural database's kilogram of peat in the biotic compartment is the growing medium (#354, following #160's fuel-versus-growing-medium distinction); wood and biomass energy rows go to the published `Wood` and `Biomass` megajoule flows their sibling lists reach; the two rows whose names state their own energy content are rebased at the vendor's own numbers (`unit-change-allowlist.json`); and oil-field off-gas keeps its own flow, because #80 settled that mine off-gas is not natural gas and the same reasoning holds at an oil well.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's biotic kilogram of peat reaches Peat, Horticulture, not the megajoule fuel
expectations.comment: The issue's peat example, 2,192 processes. On the build of 1 September 2026 this kilogram row matched the fuel `Peat` (megajoules) with `has_unit_mismatch` set -- a growing medium priced as fuel across a silent quantity crossing, the exact reading #160 declined from the factor side. The curated target sends it to the kilogram growing-medium flow in its own compartment; same unit, no conversion. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: The bare-heading Peat row is re-filed biotic and reaches the same growing medium
expectations.comment: The same kilogram of peat under the vendor's bare `Resources /` heading, which the compartment rule read as a ground resource -- so on the build of 1 September 2026 it crossed onto the megajoule fuel in the ground context. Re-filed to `Resources / biotic` beside its twin (`agribalyse-3.2-manual-fixes.json`) and sent to the growing medium with it. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's unqualified gross-calorific-value row reaches the Biomass flow ecoinvent and BAFU reach
expectations.comment: 2,855 processes -- biomass energy is what an agricultural database is about. ecoinvent 3.8 and 3.12 send the identical unqualified name to the published `Biomass` megajoule flow by prepared match and BAFU reaches it by label; on the build of 1 September 2026 AGRIBALYSE's row minted a duplicate beside it. The qualified `..., Primary Forest` flow stays separate for every list. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: Wood and wood waste, 9.5 MJ per kg is rebased at its own number onto the Wood flow
expectations.comment: An ecoinvent 2 name that asserts its own conversion, the `Uranium, 451 GJ per kg` shape. The published list keeps wood energy in megajoules; the row is rebased at the 9.5 MJ/kg its name states (`agribalyse-3.2-match-overrides.json`, accepted in `unit-change-allowlist.json`) instead of minting a kilogram flow with a factor in its name, which is what the build of 1 September 2026 did. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: Gas, off-gas, oil production mints its own flow rather than landing on natural gas
expectations.comment: The #190 triage sent this row to #354 as an energy-unit question, and the answer is a deliberate-behaviour guard rather than a fix: #80 settled that mine off-gas is not natural gas, an oil well's off-gas is the same question, and the build of 1 September 2026 already minted it faithfully. This claim pins the mint so a future widening of a natural-gas rule cannot absorb the row. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: No flow is published under AGRIBALYSE's Energy, From Wood spelling
expectations.comment: The build of 1 September 2026 published two -- one of them in a ground context, from the bare-heading row. With the twin re-filed and both rows sent to `Wood`, nothing mints under this spelling; `Energy, From Biomass` and the unqualified gross-calorific-value spelling retire the same way through their own overrides. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.

expectations.title: The megajoule fuel Peat is published in the ground and nowhere else
expectations.comment: On the build of 1 September 2026 the biotic `Energy, From Peat` row minted a biotic copy of the megajoule fuel, and the biotic kilogram of peat then found a fuel flow inside its own compartment to cross onto. Fuel peat is a ground resource -- the baseline files it there and #160 keeps the growing medium apart -- so the biotic row is re-filed to `Resources / in ground` with its two siblings (`agribalyse-3.2-manual-fixes.json`) and the copy never mints. `Peat, Horticulture` is a different name and is untouched by this claim. Drop the pending flag when the shared build first merges agribalyse-3.2.
